value.rationale: The same-data cycle and signed positional-jump law reveals a sharp sign phase distinction for opposite jump directions, exact conservation of the conditional mean over all positive jump sizes, and a strict convex-order contrast at a unit jump. These properties address an intrinsic joint-statistics question where marginal equidistribution is insufficient, furnishing exact null calibrations with a short structural proof.
